name: GET /api/leadflow/pipeline/vocabulary - The closed vocabularies a stage change must use
description: Returns the dispositions, close reasons and lost-reason codes the pipeline accepts, straight from config/verticalProfile.ts. A CLOSED SET SERVED FROM ONE PLACE is the whole value: a client that hardcodes its own copy drifts from the server the first time a reason is added or retired, and the failure surfaces as a stage change refused for a reason the operator can see in their own dropdown. No upstream and no database, so it neither degrades nor needs a producer. QA: depends on register and login for the bearer token.

testCases.name: The three vocabularies, and the file they are served from
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
